title: High Molecular Weight DNA Extraction from Recalcitrant Plant Species for Third Generation Sequencing
protocol: Grind 1 gram of tissue, preferably fresh or snap frozen, into fine powder in liquid nitrogen with a mortar and pestle.
Transfer ground tissue immediately to capped 250 mL bottle containing 10 mL NIB.
Cap the bottle and attach it to an end over end mixer, rotating at maximum speed for 15 min at 4°C.
Lay bottles on their side on a shaker at 150 rpm.
Transfer ground tissue to a beaker capped with foil and mix on stir plate with stir bar at 4 °C for 15 minutes.
Filter homogenate through 5 layers of Miracloth into a 50 mL conical tube using a funnel.
Centrifuge the filtered sample at 4 °C for 20 min at appropriate speed based on genome size.
Decant the supernatant and add 1 mL cold NIB to the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet with a paint brush pre-soaked in NIB.
Transfer 1 mL of nuclei suspension to a 15 mL conical tube.
Bring the volume up to 15 mL with ice-cold NIB.
Centrifuge at same speed and temperature as used in step 2 for 10 minutes.
Decant supernatant if it is clear after centrifugation.
Resuspend nuclei pellet in NIB, bringing volume up to 10-15 mL, and repeat centrifugation under conditions used in step 5 if supernatant remains colored.
Remove supernatant and resuspend in 1 mL 1X HB.
Spin down nuclei suspension in a 1.5 mL tube at 5000-7000 x g for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant from the spun nuclei suspension.
Snap freeze the nuclei in liquid nitrogen if snap freezing is chosen, then store at -80 °C.
Resuspend isolated plant cell nuclei with 30 μL of Proteinase K and vortex on high until fully resuspended.
Spin tube on mini-centrifuge for 2 s to remove liquid from cap.
Optional: Add 10 μL of RNase A and pulse vortex 5X to mix.
Spin tube on mini-centrifuge for 2 s to remove liquid from cap after adding RNase A.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature (RT) (18–25 °C) for 3 min.
Add 80 μL Buffer PL1 to the sample.
Pulse vortex the sample 10 times to mix thoroughly.
Spin the tube on a mini-centrifuge for 2 seconds to remove liquid from the cap.
Incubate the sample on a ThermoMixer at 55 °C and 900 rpm for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge the lysate for 5 minutes at 16000 x g at room temperature.
Transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL Protein LoBind microcentrifuge tube using a wide bore pipette.
Add Nanobind disk to the supernatant followed by 1X volume of isopropanol.
Carefully mix for 20 min at room temperature.
Verify that the fluid is continuously mixing and that the Nanobind disk remains submerged in the binding solution throughout the process.
Mix tubes by inversion every 2-3 minutes if a HulaMixer is not available.
Place tubes in magnetic tube rack.
While the tube is on the magnet, discard the supernatant, avoiding contact with the Nanobind disk.
Add 500 μL of Buffer PW1 to the tube.
Inversion mix 4X and replace the tube rack on the magnetic base.
Discard the supernatant after mixing.
Repeat step of adding 500 μL of Buffer PW1, inversion mixing, replacing on magnet, and discarding supernatant.
Remove any residual liquid from the cap of the 1.5 mL tube.
Spin the tube on a mini-centrifuge for 2 seconds.
Remove the residual liquid after spinning.
If the Nanobind disk is blocking the bottom of the tube, gently push it aside with the tip of the pipette.
Repeat step of spinning and removing residual liquid until the tube and Nanobind appear dry.
Add 50-200 μL Buffer EB to the tube.
Spin the tube on a mini-centrifuge for 2 s.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 min.
Confirm the entire Nanobind disk is fully immersed in Buffer EB during elution.
Collect extracted DNA by transferring eluate to a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube using a wide bore pipette.
Spin the tube on a mini-centrifuge for 5 s and transfer any remaining eluted DNA.
Repeat if necessary.
Analyze the recovery and purity of the DNA by NanoDrop and Qubit.
Input 1.5 μg of gDNA sheared to 8 kb with the Diagenode Megaruptor.
Shear gDNA to 10 kb using Covaris G-tubes at 5000 x g for 1 minute each way as an alternative method.
Optionally, do not shear the gDNA and perform the ligation protocol directly.
Include a size selection step with the Blue Pippin (Sage Sciences) if recommended.
Double the end repair (NEBNext Ultra II) volumes to 100 µl buffer and 14 µl enzyme.
Incubate the reaction at 20 °C for 20 minutes.
Heat inactivate the reaction at 65 °C for 20 minutes.
